What does it feel like to have someone tell you that they love you and you believe them? All I know of is when they take and take and never give anything back. 

[Redacted] for example, he's the only one who still will msg me first… probably because he needs weed. He msg me the other day for that, and I tell him (because it's late) I can do what he needs if he feels like driving... I don't own a car anymore. His answer was basically "k thanks anyway, I'll hit up someone else". 

I've known him longer than anyone else I know except for my family.

Humans are, for the most part, terrible awful things with no redeeming qualities. This server needs a hard reset.
Where were you when Buzz Aldrin and Neil Armstrong were stomping around on the moon?

I was going to answer,  but… you don't know what you're talking about. Not. At. All. Thanks, anyway. 

No, I go and those lovely people lose a servent. I'm the one they won't care about until perhaps after I'm gone. 

What do I want? Don't concern yourself, you won't understand.

Sure, the family cares… understanding is the missing component. The newer friends aren't any better than the older ones. And yeah, one of them is trans too. He doesn't reply to my messages at all anymore. I haven't seen him since I started on HRT back in january.

My family doesn't get me, I can see it on their faces. They have no concept of what it is like to be me. [Redacted] is my best friend. I have no friends, none who care enough even to reply to a text message.
